name: @ship/viewer
description: Ship Viewer pack — the content-renderer ROUTER (`<ship-viewer>` dispatcher). Reads a resolved source, resolves the renderer through @ship/sui-media's pure createMimeRegistry() engine seeded with this router's default kind→TAG table, and renders the matching child via `{#match kind()}`. Leaf renderers are the @ship/sui-media `sui-media-*` tags; markdown/code/json/diff/tabular arms compose @ship/sui-primitives. The pdf kind renders a graceful 'coming soon' fallback until `sui-media-pdf` ships.
